needs.why_existing_wont_do: The grant_ability static and grant_keyword static only affect objects on the battlefield (the packet notes 'a granted activated ability works on the battlefield only'); cycling exists only as a card's own is_cycling ability with active_zones ["hand"], and no static_effect or affects filter reaches cards in hand.
